fusion-cap is 8 cases/218 recorded entries, not the ordinary fusion suite of 4 cases/26 checkpoints. It covers normal-rarity weapon materials and constructed cost extremes.

No eight-rarity opening matrix, drag-and-drop, protected fusion confirmation or three-relic fusion suite was executed here. Core inventory locks and cross-tab confirmation protection are separate verified flows.
No new runtime dependency was introduced. Fusion cap enforced loopback-only requests with no external requests, failed requests or HTTP errors; this does not certify every game flow fully offline.
375px is a logical viewport of the fusion surface; 3840px title sizing and SwiftShader recovery are not physical phone/GPU/4K display results.
visibilitychange and missing RAF delivery are synthetic faults, not OS background/suspend testing.
